title: Do not recommend
text:
The quality of these shirts was poor. For the monthly price I expected more, especially from Disney brand items. I have a closet with wonderful Disney shirts and tank tops but these do not match their quality. It was not the usual Disney material that I usually expect.

The sizes run small. My son wears this better and he is 4’11” and 110lbs. For my stature 5’2” and 130lbs, I think medium would have fit more comfortably.
label: negative
